title: Wave coarsening drives time crystallization in mechatronic metamaterials
title_zh: 波粗化驱动机械拓扑材料中的时间结晶
abstract: When metals are magnetized1, emulsions phase separate2, or galaxies cluster3, domain walls and patterns form and irremediably coarsen over time. This coarsening is universally driven by diffusive relaxation towards equilibrium. Here we discover a vibrational counterpart—wave coarsening—in active elastic media4–13: vibrations emerge and spontaneously grow in wavelength, period and amplitude, before a globally synchronized state called a time crystal14–17 forms. We observe wave coarsening in one- and two-dimensional mechatronic metamaterials and capture its dynamical scaling. We further arrest the process by breaking momentum conservation and reveal a far-from-equilibrium nonlinear analogue to chiral topological edge modes18–24. Our results open new questions about the transient physics of systems with non-potential interactions15,25–28 and suggest an organizing principle for nonlinear waves in acoustics29,30, optomechanics31,32, living matter6,33 and soft robotics9. Wave coarsening in active elastic media is a phenomenon in which vibrations spontaneously increase in wavelength, period and amplitude before forming a globally synchronized time crystal.
abstract_zh: 当金属被磁化1、乳液相分离2或星系团聚3时，域壁和图案形成并随时间不可逆地粗化。这种粗化普遍由扩散松弛向平衡驱动。在此，我们发现一种振动对应——波粗化——在活性弹性介质中：振动产生并自发地在波长、周期和幅度上增长，随后形成一个全局同步的状态，即时间晶体14–17。我们在一维和二维机械拓扑材料中观察到波粗化，并捕捉其动力学量规。我们进一步通过打破动量守恒来抑制该过程，并揭示了一种远非平衡的非线性类似手性拓扑边缘模式的现象18–24。我们的结果为具有非势相互作用系统的暂态物理开启了新问题，并暗示了声学29,30、光机械31,32、生物质6,33和软机器人9中非线性波的组织原则。机械拓扑材料中的波粗化是一种振动自发增加波长、周期和幅度随后形成全局同步时间晶体的现象。
